exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 200 mothers at a tertiary care hospital (100 who delivered vaginally and 100 who delivered via cesarean section)
finding: Cesarean sections were associated with lower rates of breastfeeding initiation within an hour of delivery and higher breastfeeding challenges compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were associated with lower rates of breastfeeding initiation within an hour of delivery and higher breastfeeding challenges compared to vaginal delivery.
